title: Sweep remaining ULA routing behavior beyond hybrid.rs
description: Follow-up sweep after i72x.3 (hybrid.rs). Land AFTER i72x.3. Verify: cargo test -p lichen-node -p lichen-gateway + python routing/coap test suites green.
